title: Keep GUI command keys out of the DOS Control-Break input path
description: B01. Root cause: os/milton/kbd.c:351 queues each key in the DOS cooked ring before :364 also posts it to FLAIR; :254 translates Ctrl-C to 03h. os/milton/int21.c:5389 polls that stale byte for BREAK ON and :5392 invokes INT23, whose default terminates at :5341. The desktop itself polls DOS time at os/milton/kmain.c:7412. This is shared input ownership, not a failing Scrap put. Ground truth: CLAUDE.md Rule 2 does not authorize killing a GUI session for Copy; the local Macintosh System Software Users Guide V6.0, printed pp.125 and 152, describes accessory/document clipboard work. spec/toolbox_gate.h Sec 12 defines the Scrap seam; ADR-0003 Amendment DEC-16 governs the DOS break checkpoints. Scope: Give the active GUI and DOS console explicit input ownership across entry, exit and SAMIR suspension. Consume GUI chords once; preserve authentic DOS Ctrl-C and extended-key/typeahead behavior when DOS owns input. Do not fix this by globally disabling BREAK or removing INT23. Acceptance oracle: Extend keyboard/ring and INT21 host ownership tests, then lock copybreak in QEMU and a Bochs leg: Copy, idle through a clock poll, Paste, drag, close and relaunch must work with no INT23-BREAK/INT21-EXIT. A restored dual-ring leak mutant must terminate/fail this oracle; DOS prompt and child Ctrl-C controls must still pass. Record a record-flair clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/262-copybreak-before.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/263-copybreak-after-copy.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/265-copybreak-unresponsive.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/copybreak-serial.log; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/scraplimit-serial.log

title: Use current text-window geometry and repaint every scroll change
description: B02. Root cause: os/apps/itext/itext.c:74 fixes CONT_W/CONT_H/WRAP_W and :501 initializes wrapping once; :521 handles updates without adopting resized content geometry. show_caret changes g_scroll at :227 before capturing was at :235, so a successful bar round-trip hides that movement and leaves g_full false. paint skips earlier rows at :186. Ground truth: ../system7-decomp/specs/toolbox/textedit.md Sec 4 defines wrapping by destRect and clipping/scrolling by viewRect. The audit LINES25 and WRAP fixtures independently expose stale pixels and unreachable text. Scope: Share actual content width/height among wrapping, drawing, hit testing, scroll extent and caret following. Capture the pre-change scroll offset and fully repaint whenever it changes. Preserve text bytes and selection across resize; a horizontal route is acceptable only if it actually exposes all text. Acceptance oracle: Extend test-itext-route/test-textedit with shrink/grow, coordinate and line-visibility assertions. Extend test-flair-itext-scroll with the LINES25 typing sequence and compare the immediate framebuffer with a forced full repaint. Proposed ITEXT_MUT_FIXED_GEOMETRY and ITEXT_MUT_SCROLL_PARTIAL mutants must fail the geometry and immediate-repaint checks respectively. Require a locked trace and record-flair clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/083-text-wrap-original.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/087-text-wrap-shrunk.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/088-text-caret-offscreen.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/093-text-scroll-before-refresh.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/094-text-scroll-after-refresh.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/fixtures/LINES25.TXT; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/text-serial.log

title: Commit ledger Return input and display file-copy failures
description: B03. Root cause: os/apps/calc/calc.c:186 commits only CR although the event path delivers LF (the paired handling is documented at os/apps/itext/itext.c:454). calc.c:172 drops the immediate tbx_file_copy result and :175 drops every TBX_EVT_FILECOPY completion. os/milton/kmain.c:5258 returns rate/open errors through that event. Ground truth: PRD 6.5 promises an editable grid; spec/toolbox_gate.h Sec 12 defines FILECOPY error/completion delivery. Commit-on-Return and visible Save failure are ordinary document contracts, rather than measured Lotus UI claims. Scope: Accept both cooked Return encodings. Display a bounded, gate-valid explanation for immediate and asynchronous copy errors, identifying missing input/configuration where known and retaining pending entry/state. Keep document persistence and replacement confirmation on initech-qxft. Acceptance oracle: Extend harness/proptest/test_calc_tenant.c/test_calc_file_copy.c with CR/LF and immediate/completion refusal cases. Replay apps, copy-zero/bad/empty/missing and missingledger; assert committed value and visible error, with old TABLES.TXT unchanged on refused setup. Restore CR-only and dropped-error mutants to prove failure. Record a record-flair clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/101-ledger-return.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/102-ledger-committed.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/171-copy-zero-end.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/175-copy-bad-end.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/177-copy-empty-end.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/179-copy-missing-end.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/251-copy-missingledger.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/extracted-copy/summary.json; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/apps-serial.log; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/missingledger-serial.log

title: Let Calculator participate in shutdown and explain a refused quit
description: B04. Root cause: os/apps/calcda/calcda.c:43 installs only Close W and :110 handles only that menu word. os/flair/tbxgate.c:1550 searches for a literal enabled Quit item, returns -1 at :1557, and os/milton/kmain.c:5720 explains cannot-ask only to serial before silently cancelling. Ground truth: The Macintosh guide printed p.125 documents Close as an accessory lifecycle route. spec/toolbox_gate.h Sec 11 and kmain.c:5695 cite cancellable shutdown. This is Calculator integration, not the separate initech-cqej missing declining-app/Bochs acceptance work. Scope: Provide an explicit quit/close-request contract for a documentless accessory and wire Calculator to it; retain Close W. Any genuinely unaskable/declining app must leave the desktop usable with a visible reason. Do not kill document tenants as a generic fallback. Acceptance oracle: Extend test-calcda routing and shutdown host tests; lock Calculator -> Finder -> Shut Down and Restart emulator legs, plus a dirty Text cancel control. A Close-only/unaskable mutant must fail the Calculator leg. Coordinate Bochs coverage with initech-cqej and record a record-flair clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/232-calc-shutdown.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/calcdeep-serial.log; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/260-paint-shutdown-refusal.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/243-text-shutdown-completed.png

title: Redraw both menu bars after applying desktop preferences
description: B05. Root cause: os/flair/cp_service.h:53 marks pattern/clock changes dirty. os/milton/kmain.c:7397 responds with desktop_paint_all and content repaint but draws only MenuClock at :7403. The required complete menu-bar passes exist in os/flair/shell.c:369, including the system bar at :378. Ground truth: PRD 6.3 and CLAUDE.md Law 4 require working menus and the deliberate stacked bars. shell.c:369 defines their compositor order; the intentional second bar is not the defect. Scope: Use the normal composition path to repaint both installed bars and the clock after a preference redraw, preserving current foreground menus, modal layering and cursor save-under. Apply the same rule to temporary Sound preview if it triggers dirty redraw. Acceptance oracle: Extend test-flair-cpanels-settings/persist with pattern, clock show/hide and mouse changes followed by exit and actual menu activation. Grade complete bar strips against independent pre-change captures under a locked clock. Omitting the system-bar repaint must make a mutant red. Record a record-flair clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/062-pattern-applied.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/069-special-menu.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/071-after-restart.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/249-mouse-fast-motion.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/main-serial.log; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/cpdeep-serial.log

title: Activate an already-running accessory and report slot capacity clearly
description: B06. Root cause: os/flair/tbxgate.c:1404 refuses every occupied-slot launch before comparing the requested identity with g_slot.file. os/milton/kmain.c:3132 maps all negative launch results to FINDER_WIN_ERR_LAUNCH, so same-accessory activation and a different-app capacity refusal become the same generic error. Ground truth: Macintosh System Software Users Guide V6.0 printed p.125 (evidence/references/mac-guide.txt:5664) explicitly says choosing the accessory again activates its window. Scope: Compare full installed application identity and activate the existing tenant for the same accessory without reinitializing it. Explain the current slot limit for a different app. Additional co-resident slots remain on initech-smp0/initech-62hy; this batch does not refile that architecture feature. Acceptance oracle: Add host launch/activation tests for same executable, same basename in different directories and different app. Replay dalife and Finder/Apple repeated launches; edited Note Pad bytes and page must survive with no reentry. A mutant restoring unconditional busy must fail. Record a record-flair clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/234-note-duplicate-launch.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/044-scrapbook-second-app.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/dalife-serial.log; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/main-serial.log

title: Keep the film ledger total within its reachable content area
description: B07. Root cause: os/flair/film_scene.h:12 shrinks the ledger frame to 300x220. os/apps/calc/calc.c:74 still paints a 353x252 body and :92 draws the total at local (204,194); the smaller document content bottom clips it. The app has no scroll extent setup or update-time geometry adaptation. Ground truth: PRD 6.5 and Appendix A require the live ledger and its total; the audit reference film-preview.webp shows that total. The existing authored rest-state geometry contradicts its own implemented content, independently of the missing expense-table fidelity work. Scope: Derive layout/scroll bounds from the current content rectangle or set a minimum fitting film size. Make the total reachable in the supplied rest state and after user shrink/grow. Keep its amount, 570- and the 116% chart unchanged. Coordinate visual layout with initech-c7u1. Acceptance oracle: Extend test-film-scene/test_calc_tenant.c with content-bounds assertions; extend test-flair-live-scene to dismiss the modal, move the chart aside and inspect the total before and after resize. A proposed FILM_MUT_CLIP_TOTAL mutant restoring the clipping size/fixed-layout pair must fail. Record a record-flair clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/187-film-data-escape.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/190-film-ledger-edit.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/100-ledger-launch.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/references/film-preview.webp; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/filmdata-serial.log

title: Show the actual film startup failure on the panic screen
description: B08. Root cause: os/milton/kmain.c:7084 sends missing-volume, missing-APPS and any CALC load failure to flair_desktop_oom at :7086. That sink prints only FLAIR heap exhausted on screen at :921, including when no allocation failed. harness/film_scene.mk:14 supplies the data image to the accepted scene leg. Ground truth: CLAUDE.md Rule 2 permits a contextual panic for an invariant failure. evidence/film-serial.log reports FAT mount failure before the launch panic; shots/180-film-rest.png visibly misidentifies it as heap exhaustion. The audit request that absent required media never panic is not the project policy. Scope: Preserve the halt policy but carry the mount/load status and a short accurate visible reason identifying the missing required data disk or CALC asset. Distinguish allocation failures. State the two-image requirement in the launch instructions; a new single-disk packaging promise is not implied by this defect. Acceptance oracle: Add a host failure-to-message mapping test and emulator no-data/missing-APPS/missing-CALC controls alongside the normal attached-data scene leg. The screen must show the real cause and the normal control must boot. A mutant routing all statuses to OOM must fail the pixel/text check. Record the GUI/panic acceptance clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/180-film-rest.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/185-film-panic-unresponsive.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/186-film-data-rest.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/film-serial.log; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/filmdata-serial.log

title: Make Scrapbook capacity notices fit the alert contract
description: B09. Root cause: os/apps/notepad/notepad.c:299 passes a 49-byte single line to notice, which ignores tbx_alert failure at :128. spec/toolbox_gate.h:689 allows only 47 bytes plus NUL per line and :690 caps it at 285 Chicago pixels. os/flair/tbxgate.c:882 rejects its byte length; its measured advance is also 296 pixels, so simply increasing byte capacity would not fix it. Ground truth: spec/notepad/store.h locks the 32-clip capacity; spec/toolbox_gate.h Sec 11 locks alert limits. The ordinary capacity-feedback contract is the auditor stated usability basis, not a claim of changed clip limits. Scope: Split/shorten the full and too-large notices into valid lines, check the alert result, and give an actionable visible message without modifying any clip. Audit the nearby TEXT-only notice against the same constraints. Keep the strict gate validator. Acceptance oracle: Extend test-scrapbook-route with the real alert byte/width validator rather than a success-only alert mock. Replay scrapcapacity at 32/33 and an oversized-clip control; independently decode SCRAPBK.DAT and compare unchanged records. A proposed DA_MUT_OVERLONG_NOTICE mutant restoring the overlong line must fail. Record a record-flair clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/272-scrap-32-real.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/273-scrap-full-real.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/scrapcapacity-serial.log; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/extracted-scrapcapacity/SCRAPBK.DAT

title: Give Standard File filename fields caret and selection editing
description: B10. Root cause: os/milton/kmain.c:4975 draws only an end caret; :5092 handles end Backspace and :5093 appends printable bytes without checking command modifiers. :5192 copies the default name without selection state. The filename field has no caret/range model. Ground truth: The independent Mac OS 8 save-dialog capture evidence/references/s8_sf_saveas_default.png shows the selected default name; ../system7-decomp/specs/toolbox/textedit.md Sec 2 supplies the range model. Home/End key details are the audit usability expectation and need a captured contract before claiming native parity. Scope: Use the shared edit model for selection, cursor movement, replacement and deletion; initially select the supplied default name. Ctrl-A must select rather than append A. Keep filename validation feedback on initech-oobx (L017), and retain DOS 8.3 policy. Acceptance oracle: Extend Standard File host UI routing tests and test-stdfile, then lock new-name typing, Ctrl-A, Home/End, Shift selection and replacement cancellation in an emulator Save As trace. A no-initial-selection or append-command-letter mutant must fail. Require independent capture pixels and a record-flair clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/028-text-save-dialog.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/029-text-saved.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/035-save-name.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/036-save-result.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/references/s8_sf_saveas_default.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/main-serial.log

title: Add anchored Shift-arrow selection to the shared text applications
description: B11. Root cause: os/apps/itext/itext.c:444 sends arrow tokens without Shift state; os/apps/notepad/notepad.c:403 does the same. os/flair/textedit.c:351 has only collapse/move semantics and :377 sets both selection ends to the same offset. Shift-click selection already exists, but keyboard extension does not. Ground truth: ../system7-decomp/specs/toolbox/textedit.md Sec 2 defines half-open selection and active endpoint state. Shift-arrow itself is the auditor stated period-editing expectation; capture its exact boundary/reversal rules independently rather than claiming the generic TEKey spec proves them. Scope: Add an anchor/moving-end keyboard adapter shared by Text and Note Pad. Support left/right/up/down extension, reversal, collapse without Shift and document/wrapped-line boundaries while preserving text. Acceptance oracle: Extend test-textedit/test-itext-route/test-notepad-route with independently specified selections and keyboard sequences; replay the three-line Shift-Left case in both apps. A mutant dropping Shift or moving the anchor must fail. Add a locked emulator trace and record-flair clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/025-text-typed.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/026-text-shift-select.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/097-note-long.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/098-note-shift.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/main-serial.log; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/text-serial.log

title: Provide bounded Undo for destructive InitechText edits
description: B12. Root cause: os/apps/itext/itext.c:103 permanently disables Undo; the edit dispatch at :485 has no E_UNDO case and replace_sel at :412 retains no inverse edit. This is a never-built Undo entry point, not an enabled command that lost its history. Ground truth: Independent Mac OS 8 evidence/references/s8_simpletext_editmenu.png shows Undo; the local TextEdit selection contract supplies offsets. Capture the period one-level edit/undo behavior before choosing coalescing or redo semantics. Scope: First pickup: bounded one-level recovery of Cut/Clear/Paste/typing, including selection and dirty state, with no-op behavior when nothing is undoable. Reset history safely for New/Open. Reuse the document engine rather than a private second editor. Acceptance oracle: Extend test-itext-route with exact before/after bytes for Cut -> Undo, paste replacement and capacity rejection. Replay main and verify both visible restored text and saved bytes. A no-snapshot/no-undo mutant must fail. Record a record-flair clip; do not claim unimplemented multi-level history. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/027-text-cut-undo.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/references/s8_simpletext_editmenu.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/main-serial.log

title: Connect Calculator Copy and Paste to the shared Scrap
description: B13. Root cause: os/apps/calcda/calcda.c:48 disables all Edit rows, including Copy/Paste at :52; :109 handles only File Close. No result-to-Scrap or Scrap-to-number path exists although the shared Scrap gate is implemented. Ground truth: Macintosh System Software Users Guide V6.0 printed p.127 / PDF p.147 explicitly supports copying results and pasting numbers; evidence/references/mac-calc-147.png is the independent page. spec/calcda/calcda_vectors.tsv governs existing arithmetic. Scope: Enable result Copy and validated numeric Paste through the existing text Scrap. Preserve calculator state on invalid/empty clipboard data and define accepted numeric syntax from a real-Mac fixture. Coordinate B01 input isolation; arithmetic must keep its existing semantics. Acceptance oracle: Extend test-calcda and the tenant route mock with exact Scrap strings and independent numeric paste vectors. Lock Calculator Copy -> close -> Text Paste and Text Copy -> close -> Calculator Paste emulator legs. A drop-Copy/ignore-Paste mutant must fail; record a record-flair clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/024-calc-edit-settled.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/references/mac-calc-147.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/main-serial.log

title: Add cancellation to the real modal FILE COPY operation
description: B14. Root cause: os/milton/kmain.c:5282 absorbs every event in the real copy loop and never checks Cancel/Escape. os/flair/dialog.c:1101 builds only two display items with no cancel item at :1103. No cancellation route is implemented. Ground truth: PRD 6.5 / Appendix B defines the paced real FILE COPY operation; spec/toolbox_gate.h Sec 12 defines completion. A Cancel affordance is the auditor stated long-operation usability expectation, not evidence that the staged film prop writes files. Scope: Add a visible cancel control and Escape handling with one explicit cancelled completion. Coordinate atomic staging with initech-mcep and destination/persistence semantics with initech-qxft so cancellation preserves the old destination and discards only incomplete temporary output. Preserve the configured progress rate. Acceptance oracle: Extend test_calc_file_copy host tests for cancellation before open, mid-copy and near completion; replay apps at a slow rate on copied media and compare old destination/source bytes with mtools. An ignored-cancel mutant must fail promptly and unchanged-disk assertions must hold. Add a record-flair clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/107-ledger-copy-cancel.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/apps-serial.log

title: Build a bounded usable InitechPaint drawing surface
description: B15. Root cause: os/apps/paint/paint.c:102 handles update by filling a white canvas; the only other route at :107 is Quit. There is no image model, tool state or mouse stroke consumer. :34 disables all other menu rows. Ground truth: PRD 6.5 says Paint primarily carries the canonical Photoshop menu; it does not establish full Photoshop parity. PRD 1.4 and the auditor stated paint-program expectation ground this additional feature. CLAUDE.md freezes the menu titles, not a ban on drawing. Scope: First bounded pickup: retained monochrome raster plus pencil/eraser strokes that survive repaint, movement and resize; expose actual tool selection. Fill, selection, patterns and layers remain explicit later slices on the feature. Keep the canonical menu titles and do not enable nonexistent actions. Acceptance oracle: Add a host raster/stroke oracle with independently specified boundary pixels, clipping and erase expectations; lock an emulator draw -> obscure/reveal -> resize trace and grade the retained picture. A drop-stroke or clear-on-update mutant must fail. Record a record-flair clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/126-paint-actual.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/127-paint-draw-actual.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/129-paint-edit-actual.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/132-paint-select-actual.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/134-paint-window-actual.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/painttps-serial.log

title: Add Paint picture Open and Save through one verified native format
description: B16. Root cause: os/apps/paint/paint.c:39 declares Open and Save with ITEM/G=0 and :99 has no file dispatch, chooser or codec call. The missing image file workflow is separate from the absent drawing engine. Ground truth: PRD 1.4 supplies Standard File and application services; the specific picture persistence requirement is the auditor stated ordinary paint-program expectation. Choose and lock a period native bitmap format against independent real-software files before implementation; this audit supplies no verified picture-format golden. Scope: After B15 defines retained pixels, implement one bounded independently verified bitmap import/export and shared Standard File Open/Save. Include dirty-close protection and safe failure/cancel preservation through the atomic file layer. Broader format/layer compatibility stays open on the feature. Acceptance oracle: Add host codec tests with independent period files/readback, plus a draw -> Save -> quit -> Open emulator leg with exact pixel comparison and full-disk/invalid-file controls. A dropped row or no-file-write mutant must fail. Require a locked trace and record-flair clip; a private codec round-trip alone is insufficient. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/128-paint-file-actual.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/painttps-serial.log

title: Define and render the extended MacRoman text repertoire
description: B17. Root cause: spec/assets/geneva12.h:25 bounds the authored strike to 20h..7Eh and :161 maps every other byte to the same missing-glyph box. os/apps/itext/itext.c:153 draws through that face; the audit extraction proves the original high-bit bytes survive Save. Ground truth: ../system7-decomp/specs/fonts/geneva.md:91 records a real NFNT extending through MacRoman code 217; that Geneva 9 reference establishes the repertoire, not Geneva 12 artwork. PRD 6.4 and CLAUDE.md require clean-room authored glyphs. A matching independent 12-point extended specimen/metrics must be acquired before asserting glyph fidelity. Scope: Lock the supported single-byte encoding and author its non-ASCII display repertoire with measured metrics and honest missing-glyph behavior. Keep on-disk bytes intact. initech-6grv concerns the shared Geneva 9 shape mismatch; it is not this Geneva 12 repertoire gap. Acceptance oracle: Extend font-art/metrics and text-render host oracles against an independent extended-font specimen, then open EIGHT.TXT in an emulator and extract unchanged bytes after Save. A mutant mapping one supported accented code back to missing must fail its pixel oracle. Record a record-flair clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/078-text-eightbit.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/fixtures/EIGHT.TXT; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/extracted-text/comparison.json; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/text-serial.log

title: Offer mouse reading of long Scrapbook text clips
description: B18. Root cause: os/apps/notepad/notepad.c:190 configures the shared bar for clip count/page position; :341 uses it to turn clips. Only Down/Up keys alter intra-clip g_scroll at :398. Mouse scrolling within a clip has no entry point. Ground truth: The audit explicitly bases this on usability. The Macintosh guide printed p.152 (evidence/references/mac-guide.txt:6764) warns that an oversized Scrapbook image may be fully visible only after pasting elsewhere; its bar browses clips. Do not describe the existing clip-navigation model as disproved by a native scrolling reference. Scope: Add a discoverable mouse route to read hidden lines while preserving clip navigation and persistence. Specify whether to add separate text scrolling controls or a clear mode, rather than silently repurposing the existing page bar. Priority is polish because keyboard reading already works. Acceptance oracle: Extend test-scrapbook-route with one long clip and several short clips; emulator mouse actions must expose LAST and still reach previous/next clips. A mutant ignoring intra-clip mouse steps must fail. Check saved clips unchanged and record a record-flair clip. Audit evidence: docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/257-scrap-long-before-mouse.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/258-scrap-long-mouse-no-scroll.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/shots/259-scrap-long-key-scroll.png; docs/audits/2026-10-23-das/evidence/lastui-serial.log

title: Render Calculator held-key feedback through release delivery
description: B19. Root cause: os/apps/calcda/calcda.c:102 executes immediately on mouseDown and command at :75 repaints only the readout. There is no retained pressed key or release case. os/flair/process.c:849 routes keyboard down/autoKey but its default at :856 drops mouseUp/keyUp. Ground truth: Independent real Mac OS 8 Calculator capture evidence/references/s8_calc_key7_pressed.png shows the held 7 key inverted; spec/calcda/calcda_layout.h defines this app layout. Scope: Deliver the needed release/track state through the App Contract and retain one pressed key for painting; clear it on release, drag-out or deactivation according to an independently captured rule. Preserve one arithmetic action per accepted press. Acceptance oracle: Extend test-calcda routing/render tests with down/held/drag/release and key equivalents. Add a target screenshot during the hold matched to the independent pressed capture. A no-pressed-paint or lost-release mutant must fail; record a record-flair clip.
